d: China’s first fully AI-generated feature film has flopped at the box office, raising questions about whether artificial intelligence can turn technological ambition into commercial success. In this video, Firstpost examines how Sanxingdui: Future Past, made on a budget of around $1.5 million, reportedly earned just $181,000 by Monday (October 26) despite thousands of scheduled screenings. The video explores why audiences may be embracing AI-generated short dramas on their phones but remain unconvinced by AI-made cinema.
